items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, that was the first time I heard him and Charlie Christian; they hooked up together that night, because I played the drums behind them.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was the first time I heard him and Charlie Christian; they hooked up together that night, because I played the drums behind them.
So that was my first time running into Cozy Cole, too. Man, I was looking at this cat with my mouth open, I had heard so much about Cozy Cole when I was in Florida.
